item_title: Ma'aunin Banking Cloud-Native a 2026: DORA, Platform Engineering, Sovereign Cloud, da Juriya na Aiki
excerpt: Shirin injiniya don banking cloud-native a matakin binciken DORA. Primitives biyar na platform engineering — hanyoyin shimfiɗa na Kubernetes, tashar Backstage, GitOps ta ArgoCD, shigarwar Open Policy Agent, OpenTelemetry daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe — suna samar da shaidar rajistar Mataki 8 a gudun bututun aiki. Gwajin aiwatar da fita na shekara-shekara ga CIF masu dogaro da CTPP bisa manufofin RTO da aka samo daga BIA. An magance zaɓuɓɓukan sovereign-cloud (AWS European Sovereign Cloud, Microsoft EU Data Boundary, Bleu, Thales / S3NS) a matsayin shawarwarin injiniya, ba alama ba.
